## About Claude Cowork

Claude Cowork is Anthropic's AI desktop assistant designed for autonomous knowledge work. It runs on your Mac in a virtual machine environment and can execute multi-step tasks autonomously. Key features include:

- Autonomous task execution on your computer
- File and folder management
- Web browsing and research
- Code writing and debugging
- Document creation and editing
- Multi-step workflow automation
- 11 official plugins for specialized domains (Legal, Sales, Finance, Productivity, etc.)
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors for external tool integration

## About the Legal Plugin

The Claude Cowork Legal Plugin automates contract review, NDA triage, compliance tracking, vendor checks, and legal brief preparation. It connects to Box, Egnyte, Jira, Slack, Microsoft 365, and Pramata via MCP. Key commands include /legal:review-contract, /legal:triage-nda, /legal:compliance-check, /legal:risk-assessment, /legal:vendor-check, /legal:brief, and /legal:respond.
